name: Kiliper Corporation
old_description: For over 25 years, Kiliper Corp, an Inovar company, has delivered high-quality packaging solutions with a focus on stretch sleeves, flexible packaging, and roll-fed label technologies. Known for quick turnaround times, flexible production, and dependable service, Kiliper helps brands move faster while maintaining consistent quality. From full-container decoration to high-speed labeling applications, Kiliper provides solutions designed to perform across a wide range of industries including food & beverage, household products, industrial, and more.
about:
Kiliper Corporation operates from Ames, Iowa, where it has produced packaging solutions for more than 25 years. The business was built on a family-owned foundation and now operates as part of Inovar Packaging Group, a national packaging partner that provides expanded resources and a broader manufacturing network while maintaining Kiliper's responsive, service-driven approach.

The company specializes in stretch sleeve labeling, roll-fed label technologies, and flexible packaging solutions, supported by advanced flexographic printing capabilities and deep material expertise. Its offerings include printed and laminated film solutions, sustainable and recyclable packaging options, and prepress services. Kiliper also runs an innovation lab at Inovar headquarters for research and development and provides vendor-managed inventory programs to streamline supply chains.

Kiliper serves brands across food and beverage, personal and home care, industrial, pet care, agricultural chemical, supplements and nutraceuticals, household products, and agriculture markets. Its stretch sleeves conform to container shapes using material elasticity, eliminating heat or adhesives, while roll-fed labels are designed for high-speed application and seamless container coverage.

The company emphasizes quick turnaround times, adaptable production capabilities, and a hands-on, customer-first team focused on long-term partnerships. Its differentiators include specialized expertise in stretch sleeve and roll-fed label applications, reliable processes that ensure consistent quality, and scalable support through Inovar's nationwide network.
